**Run:** Fri 22 Oct 00:00 → Sun 31 Oct 23:59 UK time
**Spend:** **$444.48** of the $450 budget

### What I did
One campaign in your account, optimised for the "Stream opened" pixel event, UK-only, running your main post. I started with three ad groups to test creative and targeting, then followed the data:

| Ad group | Targeting | Spend | Streams | Cost/stream | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A — Main post | Broad UK | $223.63 | 63 | $3.55 | Workhorse; largest volume |

Key moves: paused the ghost/study post (C) on day one after it produced no streams at ~$5/click; opened and then steadily scaled the keyword ad group (D) once it proved cheapest per stream; and held back a little budget each day so the heaviest spend landed on the Halloween weekend.
